messages:
sam_w: Heads-up — during the 10:12 deploy we saw a TTFT tail creep on several routes. not a full outage but 95/99 spikes.
anya: saw the alert. which routes? any correlation with kv-prefetch enabled?
devon: db-query-route and chat-stream are the ones. pattern looks like TTFT goes up, decode stays flat, kernel time jumps briefly.
maria: quick profiler snippet I grabbed: 
```
token_latency: { ttft_ms: 38, decode_ms: 12, kernel_ms: 22, prefetch_ms: 5 }
95th: ttft ~ 120ms (normally 45)
```

lee: interesting — kernel_ms jumping could mean kernel selector chose a slower kernel (fallback) after a prefetch miss or extra copy.
sam_w: benchbot log shows some kernel-selector fallbacks right around the spike times. @benchbot can you paste the selector trace?
benchbot: selector-trace: route=chat-stream, seq_len=128, preferred_kernel=fast_gemm_fp16, fallback_kernel=compat_slow_int8, reason=kv_prefetch_blocked
benchbot: related events: kv-prefetch:on, prefetch_queue_depth=12, prefetch_wait_ms=18
anya: so prefetch queue pile-up -> blocking path -> kernel fallback -> TTFT spike. that lines up.
devon: two action items: 1) add finer granularity metrics for prefetch lifecycle 2) attribute kernel time in token breakdown (not lumped into decode)
maria: suggestion for metric labels: token_latency(stage) with labels: stage=[prequeue, prefetch_wait, kernel_queue, kernel_exec, postproc], kernel_name, kv_prefetch=[hit,miss]
sam_w: +1. also add kernel_selected label so dashboards can show % fallbacks over time.
lee: we should sample full traces for 1 in 2000 tokens to avoid cost while still getting trace context for root causes.
anya: dashboard query examples (pseudo):
```
sum(rate(token_latency_sum{stage="kernel_exec"}[5m])) by (kernel_name)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```

devon: also recommend emitting a boolean kv_prefetch_backpressure metric when prefetch_queue_depth > threshold to correlate alerts.
maria: small instrumentation patch I drafted: 
```
metrics.emit("token_latency", {
  ttft_ms: ttft_ms,
  decode_ms: decode_ms,
  kernel_ms: kernel_ms,
  stage: stage, // prefetch_wait|kernel_exec|...
  kernel: kernel_name,
  kv_prefetch: kv_prefetch ? "hit" : "miss",
  selector_reason: selector_reason
})
```

sam_w: looks good. can we add synthetic guard that forces kernel selector to prefer fast kernel when prefetch backlog is present? probably risky but we can try on a canary.
anya: let's do a canary: chat-stream in staging with selector override + enhanced metrics. if 95p improves and overall CPU stable, roll.
devon: I'll open a small PR for the metrics + sampling traces. tagging @maria for the selector config change.
maria: will add the selector override flag and a rollplan. also will create a dashboard panel comparing kernel_selected ratio vs TTFT p95.
lee: one more: add a panel showing prefetch_queue_depth heatmap by worker to detect hot queues. that helped us find a bad partition before.
sam_w: timeline: devon PR today, maria selector flag + canary tomorrow, monitor 24h, then decide. thanks all :thumbsup:
benchbot: perf-alert cleared (TTFT p95 back to baseline) — keeping watch for 2h
